narrative.overview: Remindly's visual identity draws from the warmth and familiarity of a well-loved paper planner. The interface feels like opening that planner on a quiet Sunday morning: cream-colored pages, soft sage accents marking important dates, and a sense of calm organization. This is a personal tool, not a corporate dashboard. Every design choice reinforces approachability over efficiency-at-all-costs.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream surfaces that feel like paper, not screens
Soft sage green as the primary accent, used with intention
Rounded, friendly typography (Nunito) at every scale
Generous whitespace that lets content breathe
Subtle depth through warm-toned shadows, never harsh

rules.name: The Sage Restraint Rule
rules.body: Sage green appears on no more than 20% of any given screen. Its warmth is the accent, not the atmosphere.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: Depth is conveyed through cream-to-paper tonal shifts, not heavy shadows.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: One typeface (Nunito) carries the entire interface. Weight contrast provides hierarchy, not font switching.

rules.name: The Paper Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadows use the ink color (warm brown) at low opacity, never pure black or cool gray.

dos: Do use Cream (#faf8f4) as the primary background, never pure white (#ffffff).
Do use Nunito at every scale. Weight contrast (400/600/700) provides all the hierarchy needed.
Do keep sage green to 20% or less of any screen.
Do use warm-toned shadows (rgba with ink's warm brown hue), never cool gray or pure black.
Do use generous border-radius (10-14px) on cards and containers.
Do write friendly, encouraging copy in empty states and error messages.
donts: Don't use corporate SaaS patterns: gray-blue palettes, sharp corners, dense layouts, or clinical copy.
Don't use pure white (#ffffff) backgrounds or pure black (#000000) text.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradient text, or decorative blurs.
Don't add side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as colored accents) on cards or list items.
Don't use more than one typeface.
Don't make shadows harsh or cool-toned.
Don't use overly playful or cartoon-like elements.
Don't use dark mode or heavy dark themes.
